payload.note: Signed conditional-response axial gate: translation/hypercubic symmetry, range two, and shift equivariance reduce the actual-Gibbs averaged axial relaxation symbol to Rhat_L(p)=beta_L*omega(p)-a_L*omega(p)^2. Exact one-site covariance formulas prove the axial and mixed distance-two response coefficients a_L,m_L are strictly negative, hence -a_L>0; the only unresolved annealed sign is beta_L=1/8+3(a_L+m_L). At the all-zero off-site background, exact Laplace expansion gives Cov(z,exp z)=lambda^2/72+43 lambda^4/46656+O(lambda^6) and beta_vac=-43 lambda^2/5184+O(lambda^4)<0 at weak nonzero coupling. Thus even signed pointwise contraction is obstructed on sufficiently large volumes; only actual Gibbs averaging or genuinely nonlocal/block cancellation remains. The annealed beta sign, global Poincare/Witten theorem, and interacting H^-1 bound remain open.
